summary: Wire the matched libvirt candidate into installer package selection, corresponding-source retention, netinst payloads, and release validation. Native S0 acceptance remains open. API impact: none.

guide.reason: This changes contributor installer build and release packaging only; it adds no operator workflow or Core behavior.

api.reason: The change selects a matched Debian libvirt package set and retains its source; no Nex Controller/Core or client-facing contract changed.

roadmap.reason: The delivery wiring does not close native S0 or advance the recovery plan; native candidate acceptance remains outstanding.

state.reason: Only installer inputs and release artifacts change; no durable Nex pool or Controller state is introduced.

verification.method: Ran installer/check.sh, shell syntax validation, focused netinst/release/source-retention unit suites, and source archiving checks. The 14-test test_netinst*.py suite passed without skips in a digest-pinned Debian Trixie slim container with APT and dpkg-dev installed, using a minimal read-only snapshot without .cache. Synthetic Debian packages proved replacement is restricted to existing Source=libvirt Package+Architecture slots, while unmatched candidate binaries remain outside the repository. Separate focused checks exercised custom libvirt source retention and hash-pinned publication. No full ISO rebuild, netinst installation, external publication, or native S0 lifecycle acceptance is claimed. On 2026-09-26 the installer selector and synthetic fixtures advanced to the distinct four-patch +nex3 cohort: shell syntax passed and unittest discovery for test_netinst*.py passed 19 tests with one Debian APT prerequisite skip. This is selection validation, not a new ISO or native acceptance result. Independent review corrected stale mirrored release version predicates and confirmed the four-patch source closure; nine build-source tests and fifteen release-publish tests passed. The independent reviewer also ran 36 combined source/publish/source-bundle tests successfully.
